note: Blocks for the browser's Diablo Range materials (renderer/land/ground.js, renderer/engine/look.js 'gold'). Grass is the ground; soil only on the bank and in patches; rock only where the slope rule puts it. Approximate and illustrative.

biomeColours.note: The datapack redefines the world's biome with these colours. Grass and oak leaves take the tint; the grass texture darkens it, so the grass colour is brighter than the browser's summer ground (#957f4d to #bca36c in sRGB).

plants.note: Cured annual grass on top of grass blocks.

trees.note: Species order and weights follow land.json and biome.json (coast-live, blue, valley). Heights in metres; crowns use oakSite's radius.

roads.note: Only for sites that list roads. Asphalt, gravel tracks, dirt trails; creek crossings on a plank deck (gravel would fall).
